sources.title: Affordable Housing and Viability Supplementary Planning Guidance
sources.verified_claim: City Hall explains the London Plan affordable-housing Threshold Approach and Fast Track Route; the strategic threshold framework is a planning requirement and does not prove the affordable-housing offer or viability of a sample parcel.

sources.title: Chapter 4 Housing
sources.verified_claim: The adopted London Plan includes Policies H4-H7 on affordable housing, threshold approach, tenure and monitoring; policy thresholds and tenure splits apply to qualifying proposals rather than proving a sample parcel outcome.

sources.title: Housing schemes
sources.verified_claim: Enfield states its February 2026 Housing Delivery and Placemaking Plan supports a ten-year programme and affordable-housing funding activity; a council pipeline does not establish that the sample parcel is a programme site.

sources.title: Enfield sets out ambitious 10-year new homes plan to tackle housing crisis
sources.verified_claim: Enfield reports Cabinet approval of a 2026-2036 housing delivery and placemaking plan targeting 3,000 affordable homes; borough programme targets are not parcel-specific permissions or construction evidence.

sources.title: Havering Cabinet approves major Build to Rent partnership to secure long term affordable homes
sources.verified_claim: Havering reports approval of a partnership intended to deliver up to 600 affordable Build to Rent homes with first delivery expected from 2028-29; programme approval and forecast timing do not prove sample-parcel delivery.

sources.title: Are you eligible for housing?
sources.verified_claim: Havering states its September 2025 allocations scheme operates amid constrained supply, with over 3,600 applicants and 335 homes becoming available in 2025; housing-register pressure is borough need evidence, not parcel development evidence.

sources.title: Housing policies and strategies
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's official housing-policy page lists the Housing Strategy 2024-2030, Tenancy Strategy 2025 and related policies; strategic housing policy does not itself establish a sample parcel's tenure or delivery.

sources.title: Affordable Housing
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's data hub records local affordable-housing tenure policy information; local tenure expectations are proposal-level planning context and are not treated as an exact sample-parcel offer.
